parameters.name: TimeStamp
parameters.description: The timestamp of the last scan. Formatted with the date-and-time string format as defined in {{bibref|RFC3339|Section 3}}.

parameters.name: AggregateScanDuration
parameters.description: Total time spent performing the scan of this channel in {{units}}.

parameters.name: ScanType
parameters.description: Indicates whether the scan was performed passively (false) or with active probing (true).
